qa_pairs.question: What is the title and model specification for this procedure?
qa_pairs.answer: REPLACING LEFT REAR SIDE PANEL (UP TO ROOF JOINT) - TWO DOOR MODEL

qa_pairs.question: What is the main action required for the spot welds throughout this procedure?
qa_pairs.answer: Make spot welding accessible and drill out spot welds.

qa_pairs.question: After drilling out spot welds, what should be done to the brazing solder?
What special note is given for drilling in area A?
qa_pairs.answer: Drill through two panels in area (A) for version with extraction above C pillar.

qa_pairs.question: What action should be performed after uncovering spot welds?
qa_pairs.answer: Uncover spot welding and drill out spot welds.

qa_pairs.question: What image number shows the location of multiple spot welds that need to be drilled out on the lower panel?
qa_pairs.answer: Image 30 41 435 shows multiple spot weld locations marked with arrows.

qa_pairs.question: Which image shows the rear side panel separation area?
qa_pairs.answer: Image 30 41 437 shows the rear side panel separation with visible damage or cutting area.

qa_pairs.question: What is shown in the final image 30 41 441?
qa_pairs.answer: It shows uncovering spot welding and drilling out spot welds on what appears to be the lower panel section with multiple arrows indicating weld locations.
